datasets.name: Landslide inventory of Mandi and Kullu Districts
datasets.verbatim: Approximately 6500 landslides were mapped that were triggered during the 2023 monsoon season across an area of approximately 3100 km2 in the Mandi and Kullu Districts.

methods.name: Coupled hydro-mechanical finite element analysis
methods.summary: A two-dimensional finite element-based numerical model developed using Plaxis 2D to simulate the progressive failure events of a representative landslide. The model uses the elastic-perfectly plastic Mohr–Coulomb constitutive model extending Bishop’s effective stress variables to evaluate pore water pressure distribution and slope deformation under transient rainfall infiltration.
methods.verbatim: Secondly, to further investigate the underlying failure mechanism of the most common failure type identified in our landslide mapping, the findings of a coupled flow deformation analysis and safety analysis for an exemplar landslide conducted using the finite element numerical analysis software, Plaxis 2D are presented. ... To this end, a two-dimensional finite element-based numerical model of slope (based on Fig. 8) was developed using Plaxis 2D (Version 21.01.00)

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or made available, and the custom numerical model code is not provided. While other input datasets are accessible via public portals, the lack of the primary landslide inventory and the analysis code prevents reproduction.
